diagnosis: The corporate account controller returns the JPA BankAccount entity directly, which triggers Jackson serialization of the lazy-loaded @OneToMany corporateCards collection. Any user authorized to view top-level account balance inadvertently receives all executive credit card numbers, CVVs, and spending limits because child object authorization is bypassed during relationship traversal.
